title: I'm running late
setting: A phone call. Maya is already at a cafe. Chris is still at home, just heading out.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah, hi, I'm running late. I'm sorry.
lines.spoken: Yeah, hi, I'm running late. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Like... fifteen? Twenty if the light's bad. I just left the house.
lines.spoken: Like... fifteen? Twenty if the light's bad. I just left the house.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I know. I lost track of time. I was going to leave at six and then I didn't.
lines.spoken: I know. I lost track of time. I was gonna leave at six and then I didn't.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Okay. I'll just... I can wait. It's not a big deal.
lines.spoken: Okay. I'll just... I can wait. It's not a big deal.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: You sure? I don't want you sitting there by yourself like an idiot.
lines.spoken: You sure? I don't want you sitting there by yourself like an idiot.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I'm in a cafe. I'm not in a parking lot. I'll be fine.
lines.spoken: I'm in a cafe. I'm not in a parking lot. I'll be fine.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I'll be there in like fifteen, I think. I'll text you if it's worse.
lines.spoken: I'll be there in like fifteen, I think. I'll text you if it's worse.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Okay. Don't speed, just... get here when you get here.
lines.spoken: Okay. Don't speed, just... get here when you get here.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Okay. I'm coming. I'm already walking to the car.
lines.spoken: Okay. I'm coming. I'm already walking to the car.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Good. I'll get a table near the window so you can see me.
lines.spoken: Good. I'll get a table near the window so you can see me.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: That's perfect. Thank you. I'm moving, I promise.
lines.spoken: That's perfect. Thank you. I'm moving, I promise.

details.askEn: How late does Chris think he'll be?

details.askZh: Maya 说她会怎么做，好让 Chris 找到她？
details.askEn: What will Maya do so Chris can find her?
accept: get a table near the window

glue.noteZh: I'm 很弱，running late 连在一起，不要只听到 late 而丢掉进行中的 I'm running。

glue.span: I was going to leave at six
glue.hear: I was gonna leave at six
glue.noteZh: was going to 缩成 was gonna，leave at 中间的 at 也会变弱。
glue.standard: I was going to leave at six

glue.span: I'll be there in like fifteen
glue.hear: I'll be there in like fifteen
glue.noteZh: I'll be there in like 一串功能词加 like，真正的时间数到最后才出现。
glue.standard: I will be there in like fifteen

chunks.sayAfter: Yeah, hi, I'm running late. I'm sorry.

chunks.meaningZh: 大概晚多久？（把‘晚’问清楚。）
chunks.sayAfter: How late are we talking? Like fifteen?

chunks.form: I'll be there in like fifteen.
chunks.sayAfter: I'll be there in like fifteen. I'll text you if it's worse.

roleplay.setupZh: 你跟朋友约好了，但你出门晚了。对方已经到了。你要道歉，说清楚大概还要多久，但不要听起来像在编理由。
roleplay.aiRole: Maya, already at a cafe, warm and a little dry. She can wait. She will not accept 'I'm on my way' if you are still at home; she wants a real time.
variants: Chris is even later than fifteen minutes.
Maya offers to order him a drink.
Traffic gets worse and he has to text an update.
mustUse: I'll be there in like fifteen
starters: I can wait. It's not a big deal.

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲这次迟到：Chris 为什么晚了，他说还要多久，Maya 在哪儿等。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell the running-late story: why Chris is late, how long he said, and where Maya is waiting. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
